# Examples from the Overlay Specification 1.2.0

`reusable/` is the specification's "Reusable Action Reference Example - Overrides", transcribed as
printed in the specification's text at the revision named in `../README.md`: its source description
as `openapi.yaml`, its overlay as `overlay.yaml` and its result description as `output.yaml`. Unlike
the directories beside it, this one is not a copy of a file of the upstream repository.
